nodes.title: Socioeconomic mobility in the United States - Wikipedia
nodes.exact_phrasing: The article discusses how 'inter-generational mobility is lower in the US than in some European countries' and notes that 'Social mobility in the US has either remained unchanged or decreased since the 1970s,' with studies showing income inequality increasing and 'sharply reducing social mobility,' particularly noting that 'the path for black boys is steeper' in terms of upward mobility.
nodes.attribution_text: Multiple studies cited including: The Economist (2020) on Raj Chetty's findings; a 2008 study on economic mobility trends; a 2012 Pew Charitable Trusts study; a 2013 Brookings Institution study; and a 2014 academic study.
